description: Create a listing on the Geode private coin exchange: the coin you offer, the coin you want, price, payment method, inventory and location. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

asking_coin.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

city.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

country.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

inventory.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

method.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

offer_coin.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

price.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_exchange_new_listing
title: Exchange: new listing
